title: Expressing Origin & Spatial Belonging: The -beli Suffix

sections.title: Forming Adjectives of Neighborhood and Community Affiliation
sections.content: The derivational suffix *-beli* forms adjectives denoting location or belonging: *környékbeli* (local, from the surrounding area), *városbeli* (townsperson / urban), *falubeli* (fellow villager), *helybeli* (local resident).

items.spanish: A környékbeli lakók szoros baráti közösséget alkotnak.
items.english: The local residents from the neighborhood form a tight-knit friendly community.

items.spanish: A helybeli termelők minden szombaton friss zöldséget hoznak a piacra.
items.english: Local producers bring fresh vegetables to the market every Saturday.

items.spanish: A lakótelepi környezetben a zöldövezetek javítják az emberek közérzetét.
items.english: In housing estate environments, green areas improve people's wellbeing.
